note: Shared Signals from federation partners. A partner's CAEP and RISC events about the people it signs in — or, from an ssf relationship, about the people and devices it manages — are acted on only when they verified against the keys its SSF configuration names, name this stream's audience and a person the relationship links, and then only as the signal-response policy permits. Each stream is configured and acted on from its relationship's page.
